    def __init__(self, handle):
        self.handle = handle
    def __enter__(self):
        return self
    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_value, traceback):
        self.handle.close()
        state['closed'] = self.handle.closed
        return False
    def read(self):
        raise IOError('injected read failure')

    return FaultingFile(real_open(path, mode))
